lore.role: Flying construction specialist that assembles the Stålheart Terraformer before it fabricates MÖRK vehicles.
lore.name_note: Birudorōn is a playful romanization of ビルドローン: build drone. Manufacturer identity is working fiction for the remake.

design_direction.summary: Retain the readable LED face and four-limb construction silhouette, rebuilt in the MÖRK/KORP design language.
shared_language: recessed cyan lift and tool emitters
purposeful chamfers and mechanical panel breaks
design_direction.emotion_rule: Every authored emotion combines an LED-panel expression with a body, limb or tool-head gesture; the screen alone is not the performance.

assets.name: ISAO-Birudorōn / Initial concept
assets.visual_forward: -Z (concept mismatch; production remake must normalize to +Z)
known_limitations: Visible limb meshes are not parented to the supplied leg pivots
No gameplay sockets, collision proxies or damage states
Twenty-six unnamed mesh nodes and twenty-eight draw calls
Faces local -Z instead of the project +Z contract

derived_previews.purpose: 800 px gallery preview; the preserved PNG remains the reference source

future_tiers.purpose: Detailed master for close shots, animation and recordings
Game unit with functional emotion, rotor, limb and tool pivots; target at or below 25,000 triangles
Static distance/loading representation only if game camera and loading tests justify it
